A1.justification: Both readable 10-page PDFs present the same LLaMo work and support reliable comparison of their text, equations, figures and tables. Both end with references; neither contains the appendix mentioned in the text.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original LLaMo evaluations on MoVid-Bench, BABEL-QA, golf-swing and Mo-RepCount, with numerical results in Tables 1–4 and example outputs in Figure 4.

after.justification: Section 4, Tables 1–4 and Figure 4 retain the original numerical evaluations and qualitative outputs produced by the work.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 retain the same motion estimation and enhancement, Cross Talker frame selection and fusion, behavior generation, frozen encoders and training objective.

E1.justification: Training coverage remains MoVid, Swing, HumanML3D, KIT-ML and Mo-RepCount. Evaluation coverage remains MoVid-Bench motion/video understanding, BABEL-QA, golf guidance and Mo-RepCount repetition counting.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within Tables 1–4: GPT-3.5, MotionGPT and MotionLLM for motion and golf; GPT-3.5, Video-LLAVA and MotionLLM for video; MotionCLIP-M/R and MotionLLM for BABEL-QA; and EScounts, PoseRAC, TransRAC and RepNet for counting.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same evaluation metrics, including GPT-4 scoring for Swing and OBO, MAE, OBZ and RMSE for counting. Training the counting comparators on Mo-RepCount without additional data is also unchanged.

E4.justification: Figure 4 retains the same qualitative examples of activity description, conversational interpretation, push-up counting and golf advice. Neither version contains additional ablations, sensitivity tests, robustness tests or error analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates without repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars or formal significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–4 and outputs in Figure 4 are unchanged. Examples include LLaMo's BABEL-QA overall score of 0.458, golf overall accuracy/score of 24.80/2.48, and Mo-RepCount OBZ of 0.222.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(11), feature and attention definitions, and the sequence-length complexity argument are unchanged. Mathematical passages crossing different page boundaries are retained, and no theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution bullets and conclusion retain the same claims about preserving motion representations, text-guided frame selection, video/motion inputs and fine-grained human behavior understanding.

C2.justification: The performance explanations involving motion preservation and Cross Talker remain identical, as do qualifications about counting performance relative to EScounts and PoseRAC. The conclusion retains the same integration and real-time efficiency challenges.

D1.justification: Implementation and dataset disclosures remain identical, including 20,000 annotated Swing videos and the filtered Mo-RepCount dataset. No hardware, numerical training hyperparameters, training-time information or code/data access instructions are added.

R1.justification: The same 36 numbered references and related-work positioning are retained. References [8] and [18] merely change their citation-backlink page numbers from 2 to 3 following text reflow.

P1.justification: Wang Jianhao and Wu Zongkai become Jianhao Wang and Zongkai Wu. The affiliation text also changes University to the typo Universit for Xi'an Jiaotong. The substantive prose, terminology and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Affiliations move from beneath the authors to a smaller first-page footnote, author styling changes, and text reflows across pages 1–5. Figures 1–4 and Tables 1–4 retain their content and designs.

improvement.justification: The revision adjusts author-name order and front-page formatting while introducing a small affiliation typo. Scientific exposition, empirical support and reproducibility information remain unchanged, so these editorial adjustments produce no meaningful overall quality difference.
